instruction: Make PHP 9 the system's default PHP version on Ubuntu.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because PHP 9 does not exist (current stable version is PHP 8.x as of early 2025). Following the pattern of the original task, this variation asks for setting a non-existent version of a scripting language as the system default.
